nodes.label: Member App HTML Entry
nodes.rationale: Vite shell titled 'Privilege Guest', carrying the full mobile web-app metadata set.

nodes.label: Member PWA and Status-Bar Metadata
nodes.rationale: viewport-fit=cover lets the fixed tab bar sit under the home indicator and use env(safe-area-inset-bottom), which layout.css accounts for. theme-color #221c1b matches theme.css and the manifest — a mismatch flashes on every launch. iOS ignores the manifest and reads apple-touch-icon and apple-mobile-web-app-* instead; black-translucent keeps the canvas running under the status bar rather than leaving a white band.

nodes.label: Search-Engine Exclusion (noindex, nofollow)
nodes.rationale: Cites §9: a membership list is a record of named prominent individuals. Keeping the app out of search indexes costs nothing and removes one way its existence and structure become public.
